$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0. Semantics: specs/conformance/dsl.md, and specs/conformance/sync-ops.md for actor scenarios. Authoritative for the scenario file format together with those specs. Not expressed here, checked when a scenario loads: an actor step names a declared actor, and each actor's first sync step has kind login (sync-ops.md S2.3, S4.2); no media_sync precedes its actor's first sync (media-sync-ops.md V3); review_session markers alternate per actor starting begin, with no reopen/full_upload/full_download while open (S13).
title: Meguri conformance scenario

allOf.description: actor, sync, net_fault, converge and media_sync only with actors (sync-ops.md S1).
No handoff in an actor scenario (dsl.md D9.3).
No adopt in an actor scenario (normalized-dump.md N5).

id.description: The file path relative to conformance/scenarios/ without its suffix (D1).

set.description: Pointer patterns of arrays compared as multisets (observations.md O3, O7).

actors.description: The clients of a multi-party scenario; the first runs the setup (sync-ops.md S2).

clock_offset_secs.description: Seconds the server's clock runs ahead of the scenario clock (behind when negative); default 0.

actor_name.description: A Meguri actor (meguri, meguri_2, ...) or an oracle actor (client_a ... client_z), sync-ops.md S2.1.

dump_table.description: A table of a schema-18 collection file (observations.md O8).

distinct_card_refs.description: specs/conformance/sched-ops.md J1: at least one card, each listed once.

cards_or_notes.description: specs/conformance/sched-ops.md J2, J3: exactly one of cards and notes, each listed once.

media_files.description: media-ops.md F3: files and empty subdirectories created directly in the media folder, after every other setup section; names must differ after NFC under the unicase comparison (checked when the scenario loads).

deck_limit_value.description: deck-options-ops.md E1: a deck limit the save sets (an integer 0 to 9999) or clears (null).

browser_front.description: dsl.md D6.4: the browser question format (bqfmt); empty when missing.

browser_back.description: dsl.md D6.4: the browser answer format (bafmt); empty when missing.

anyOf.description: media-ops.md F9-F11: media kinds take no references.
stats-ops.md H2, H5: studied_today_raw and studied_today_text take no references.

render_status.description: render-ops.md Q4: review render status of these cards.

queue.description: queue-ops.md Q2: the current deck's study queue.

deck_counts.description: queue-ops.md Q3: the deck list's nodes with their counts.

congrats.description: queue-ops.md Q4: a finished deck's facts for the current deck.

deck_tree.description: deck-ops.md K12: the deck tree's structure (decks/decks.md D12); deck_counts reports counts separately.

decks.description: deck-ops.md K11: every deck by its stored human name.

tag_complete.description: specs/tags/complete.md C7: tag completion per case, limit Meguri's C1 limit (the oracle sends limit - 1 as Anki's match_limit); at most one request per step.

add_defaults.description: specs/notes/add-defaults.md D7: the Add screen's starting deck and note type (D1), with the review card's home deck when given; at most one request per step.

notetype_last_deck.description: specs/notes/add-defaults.md D7: a note type's default deck (D2), the note type by its stored name, or by a raw id that names no note type (a leftover key); at most one request per step.

card_excerpts.description: card-excerpt-ops.md E1: the cards' Question and Deck cells, one entry per reference in request order; repeats allowed; at most one request per step.

backup_files.description: backup-ops.md F5: the files of the backups folder.

backup_settings.description: backup-ops.md F6: the backup limits as read now.

search.description: search-ops.md S1: searches run in order, each in cards mode (default) or notes mode; browser-ops.md B1: order sorts the result by a column.

order.description: browser-ops.md B1: the column key (any string; unknown and unsortable keys give unsortable) and the direction, ascending when reverse is false or missing.

browser_rows.description: browser-ops.md B3: Browse rows for these columns, cards or notes as the config key browserTableShowNotesMode says; references of that mode's kind only; at most one request per step.

card_extractors.description: extractor-ops.md E1: the card-data SQL functions (specs/search/card-extractors.md) on given SQL values; never touches the scenario's collection. At most one per observe step, and ids unique within the request (checked when the scenario loads).

canonical_search.description: search-ops.md S2: canonical texts of search texts; never reads the collection.

search_build.description: search-ops.md S6: built search items (S5) written as search text; never reads the collection.

search_join.description: search-ops.md S6: a built item (S5) joined to an existing search text (join-and-replace.md J6); never reads the collection.

search_replace.description: search-ops.md S6: a built item (S5) put in place of an existing search's terms of its kind (join-and-replace.md J7); never reads the collection.

db_dump.description: observations.md O8: all twelve tables, or the listed ones; raw true leaves out O8's normalization of random values (normalized-dump.md N4).

stats.description: stats-ops.md H10, stats/graphs-common G14: graph data requests, each a scope, a history and the parts to return.

card_stats.description: stats-ops.md H9: Card Info's raw values for these cards, each listed once.

today_stats.description: stats-ops.md H7: scopes, each collection, {deck: name} or {search: text}.

type_answer.description: specs/conformance/type-answer-ops.md K1: the type-in comparison over [expected, typed] pairs of strings; never touches the scenario's collection.

review_html.description: specs/conformance/type-answer-ops.md K2: the HTML review shows for stored cards, with the typed text of each case (default empty); at most one request per observe step (checked when the scenario loads).

ignored_before_count.description: deck-options-ops.md E2: the count behind N of M cards included, for each date text.

legacy_json.description: model-ops.md L1: schema-11 objects of the named records.

notetype_structure.description: notetype-ops.md T8: every note type (null), or the named ones.

notetype_templates.description: notetype-structure-ops.md M3: the stored template texts of the named note types.

blob_decode.description: model-ops.md L4: whether the named records' protobuf blobs decode.

file_col.description: storage-ops.md P5: col columns of a session file a schema11_copy step wrote, read without opening it as a collection.

file_objects.description: storage-ops.md P6: schema_objects of a session file a schema11_copy step wrote.

file_query.description: storage-ops.md P7: one statement that only reads, on a session file a schema11_copy step wrote.

package_col.description: model-ops.md L7: col columns of the legacy package an export step wrote.

package_media.description: package-ops.md E10: the media map of a package in the session directory (name) or of a fixture package (fixture), with each numbered entry's decoded size.

package_db_dump.description: package-ops.md E11: db_dump's value (O8) of a package's collection entry, read with plain SQLite; tables and raw as db_dump's.

package_listing.description: package-ops.md E3: the layout of a package in the session directory (name) or of a fixture package (fixture).

cloze.description: specs/conformance/cloze-ops.md Z1: pure cloze functions over a list of inputs; [text, card] pairs (card 1-65535), or strings for numbers, which shares a request with no other function.

fsrs_next.description: float-determinism.md F5.1: FSRS next states of a stored review card per input; never touches the scenario's collection. At most one per observe step, params must name a member of param_sets, and f32 members are read per model/json-numbers N2 (checked when the scenario loads).

text.description: observations.md O4 text: pure text functions over a list of inputs; pairs for unicase_compare, which shares a request with no other function.

image_occlusion.description: specs/conformance/image-occlusion-ops.md J1: pure image-occlusion functions over a list of inputs; strings (NFC, no control character but TAB and LF) for parse, lists of field tags (0-4294967295 or null) for fields, which shares a request with no other function.

fsrs_next_input.description: float-determinism.md F2.1: one probe input, the members of a line of conformance/corpora/fp-probe/inputs.jsonl.

media_name.description: media-ops.md F3: an exact name in the media folder.

media_fill.description: media-ops.md F2: size bytes, all equal to byte (default 0).

media_file.description: media-ops.md F2: a name and its bytes, as text (UTF-8) or a fill.

search_item.description: search-ops.md S5: a built search item of join-and-replace.md J3 in its neutral form. The oracle refuses J10's inputs and J3's refusals (invalid_scenario); the schema states the shapes and number ranges.

extractor_input.description: extractor-ops.md E1: one input of a card_extractors request.

sql_input_value.description: extractor-ops.md E2: an integer is INTEGER, another number REAL, a string TEXT, null NULL; {int} an INTEGER in the signed 64-bit range (range checked when the scenario loads), {text_hex} TEXT with exactly those bytes, {blob_hex} a BLOB.

draft_args.description: Draft op arguments (dsl.md D7.2): the owning area fixes them with the driver op.

fields_check_request.description: specs/conformance/note-ops.md N4: the field check on new-note drafts (notetype, fields) or existing-note drafts (note, fields?). Field names and counts are checked when the step runs.

template_request.description: render-ops.md Q1.1: the template engine on given template texts. notetype is required when a case has no card and not allowed otherwise. Field name rules (Q1.1), ord and field-mapping checks are made when the scenario loads.

package_name.description: model-ops.md L6: a package file in the session directory.

session_file.description: storage-ops.md P8.1: a collection file in the session directory that a schema11_copy step writes; lower case only, so no name is collection.anki2 or another session file on a case-insensitive volume; never collection.anki2.

export_limit.description: package-ops.md E7: collection, a deck by its stored name, or a non-empty list of note or card references.

colpkg_name.description: package-ops.md E1, E2.1: a collection package file in the session directory.

any_package_name.description: package-ops.md E3: a package file in the session directory.

backup_file_name.description: backup-ops.md F2: one file name in the backups folder; any characters but / and NUL.

wall_time.description: backup-ops.md F2: a wall date and time with no offset.

package_fixture.description: package-ops.md E2.1, E3: a package under conformance/fixtures/, lower-case segments as open's.

review_session.description: sync-ops.md S13: begin or end on the current actor, or the collection without actors; output none. Alternation and collection-closing guards are checked at load, per actor; an open session at EOF is valid.

open.description: storage-ops.md P1: replace the collection with a copy of conformance/fixtures/<fixture>, or of the session file <file> an earlier schema11_copy step wrote, and open it. Only in scenarios with no setup whose first step is an open naming a fixture (checked when the scenario loads).

schema11_copy.description: storage-ops.md P4: write a schema-11 copy of the collection to a session file; the collection does not change.

edit_note.description: Stable (specs/conformance/record-ops.md W2): a note's fields (a list replaces from the first field, a mapping the named ones) and its tags (replaced, in order); the note area may add arguments with their driver support.

delete_notes.description: Stable (record-ops.md W3): notes to remove; those that no longer exist are skipped.

set_config.description: Stable (record-ops.md W4): one collection config key and its JSON value (null included); undoable true records an Update Config undo step (undo-ops.md V3.1).

remove_config.description: Stable (undo-ops.md V3.2): remove one collection config key as an undoable Update Config step; a missing key changes nothing.

undo.description: Stable (undo-ops.md V1): apply the top step of the undo history.

redo.description: Stable (undo-ops.md V1): apply the top step of the redo history.

add_note_tags.description: tag-ops.md G1: add the tags of the text (split at U+0020 and U+3000) to the notes (tags/tags.md T10).

remove_note_tags.description: tag-ops.md G2: remove the matching tags from the notes (tags/tags.md T10).

delete_tags.description: tag-ops.md G3: remove the tags and their descendants from every note and from the registry (tags/tags.md T9).

rename_tag.description: tag-ops.md G4: rename a tag and its descendants (tags/tags.md T7); rejection invalid_name.

reparent_tags.description: tag-ops.md G5: move tags under parent, or to the top level when parent is empty (tags/tags.md T8).

clear_unused_tags.description: tag-ops.md G6: remove registry rows no note uses (tags/tags.md T11).

set_tag_collapsed.description: tag-ops.md G7: set the collapsed state of the named tags, registering missing ones (tags/tags.md T12).

set_flag.description: tag-ops.md G8: write a flag to the cards (tags/flags-and-marked.md F2); rejection invalid_flag above 7.

browser_config_set.description: browser-config-ops.md B1: set one browser config key to a whole value of its shape, without an undo entry.

bury.description: specs/conformance/sched-ops.md J2: the user's bury of the cards (Bury Card) or of all cards of the notes (Bury Note).

suspend.description: sched-ops.md J3 (model-ops.md L3's {cards} form): Suspend Card or Suspend Note.

unsuspend.description: sched-ops.md J4: every listed card in queue -1, -2 or -3 gets its queue back from its type (an unbury too).

unbury_deck.description: sched-ops.md J5: unbury the deck and its descendants; manual is queue -3, siblings queue -2, all both.

forget.description: sched-ops.md J7: Reset in the listed order; both booleans false when missing; context writes that screen's two choice keys.

set_due.description: sched-ops.md J6: Set Due Date with the text as typed; context remembers it in setDueReviewer or setDueBrowser; rejection invalid_days.

grade_now.description: sched-ops.md J8: Grade Now with one rating, in the listed order, time 0.

empty_filtered.description: sched-ops.md J9: Empty the filtered deck; rejection not_filtered for a normal deck.

save_deck_options.description: Stable (deck-options-ops.md E1): the deck options screen's Save for deck, switched to preset, with options applied to that preset, the deck's own values (limits, deck_desired_retention) set, removed (null) or kept (missing), the global limit options set or kept, presets removed, and for all subdecks when subtree is true. The members subtree, remove, limits, globals and options.insertion_order await the driver (E3).

set_scheduling_prefs.description: Stable (deck-options-ops.md E4): the scheduling settings' save as one Preferences undo step; awaits the driver (E3).

legacy_update.description: model-ops.md L2: merge patch into a record's schema-11 object and save it.

import.description: The collection package forms are exactly {format: colpkg, fixture} or {format: colpkg, name} (package-ops.md E2); the deck package form is {format: apkg, fixture | name, merge_notetypes, update_notes, update_notetypes, with_scheduling, with_deck_configs} (package-ops.md E6); other forms are draft (package).

then.description: package-ops.md E6.1: the deck package form, exactly one of fixture and name, every option.

export.description: Stable (package): the legacy package form {format: apkg, name, legacy: true} (model-ops.md L6), the collection package form {format: colpkg, name} (package-ops.md E1) and the deck package form {format: apkg, name, limit, scheduling, presets, media} (E7). Draft until the typed model reads them (dsl.md D7.2): the collection package options form with media and legacy (E9) and the deck package form with legacy: true (E8).

oneOf.description: model-ops.md L6: the whole-collection legacy form.
package-ops.md E8: the deck package form, every key, with legacy: true.

then.description: package-ops.md E1, and E9 with media or legacy (booleans, false when missing).
package-ops.md E7: the deck package form, every key.

add_backup_files.description: backup-ops.md F2: empty files in the scenario's backups folder, named in a list or as a series of backup names from one wall time to another (inclusive) every duration. Name rules beyond this pattern (no ., .., NUL or .meguri- prefix, at most 255 bytes, at most 20,000 files, until not before from) are checked when the scenario loads.

force_backup.description: backup-ops.md F3: a forced backup into the backups folder, retention included; copy_as also copies it into the session directory. At most one per opening of the collection (F7, checked when the scenario loads).

save_backup_settings.description: backup-ops.md F4: the four backup limits, written as the settings save writes them.

backup.description: backup-trigger-ops.md H1: a backup into the backups folder, forced (force true) or periodic (force false: made only when col.mod changed since the last backup and no entry of the folder is younger than the minimum interval), retention included. The name it would take must not exist in the folder (H3).

check_db.description: Stable (collection-check.md K10): Anki's Check Database on the scenario's collection.

optimize.description: Stable (maintenance-ops.md M1): the automatic optimize, VACUUM then ANALYZE, on the scenario's collection at once; no output, no rejection.

media_outside.description: Stable (media-ops.md F4): change the media folder directly, bypassing the store: create or rewrite files, create empty subdirectories, remove entries.

add_media.description: Stable (media-ops.md F5): add a file through the media store; name is the desired name, any string.

trash_media.description: Stable (media-ops.md F6): move these files to the media trash.

restore_media_trash.description: Stable (media-ops.md F7): restore every media trash entry.

empty_media_trash.description: Stable (media-ops.md F8): delete every media trash entry permanently.

check_media.description: Draft (media-ops.md F14.1): a Check Media run to its end; its output is kept for the next delete_unused_media and tag_missing_media steps.

delete_unused_media.description: Draft (media-ops.md F14.2): trash the unused list of the latest check_media step. Between that step and this one only observe, advance, set_clock and tag_missing_media may run (checked when the scenario loads).

tag_missing_media.description: Draft (media-ops.md F14.3): add the tag missing-media to the missing_notes of the latest check_media step, as one undoable update_tag step.

media_reset.description: Stable (media-sync-ops.md V2): reset the current collection's media sync state as logging out does.

media_sync.description: Stable (media-sync-ops.md V3): the current actor runs one media sync to its end; actor scenarios only, after the actor's first sync step (a login).

db_exec.description: Stable (record-ops.md W1): one SQL statement; params bind to positional ? placeholders (string TEXT, integer INTEGER, other number REAL, null NULL; an integer outside the signed 64-bit range is invalid).

reopen.description: Close the collection and open it again from its file (sync-ops.md S6).

adopt.description: normalized-dump.md N5: give the collection's notes and cards that have no logical id the next #nN and #cN, in ascending id order. Not in actor scenarios.

enable_fsrs.description: Stable (specs/conformance/fsrs-policy-ops.md F2): turn FSRS on without rescheduling. Meguri runs enableFsrs; the oracle runs Anki's deck options save with FSRS on, which must change nothing but cards, the fsrs key and col.mod.

enable_v3.description: Stable (specs/conformance/fsrs-policy-ops.md F3): Anki's scheduler update to the current scheduler. Meguri ensures the session is Hosted, running its real engine-open normalization on promotion.

actor.description: The actor that runs the next steps (sync-ops.md S2.3); declared in actors.

sync.description: sync-ops.md S4; credentials only with kind login (S4.5); status is the sync status of specs/sync/meta-status.md M6.

add_deck.description: deck-ops.md K2: create a deck from a typed name (decks/decks.md D5); rejections filtered_parent, too_deep.

rename_deck.description: deck-ops.md K3: rename a deck, named by its stored human name, to a typed full name (decks/decks.md D6); rejections filtered_parent, too_deep, under_descendant (Meguri only).

reparent_decks.description: deck-ops.md K4: move decks under parent, or to the top level when parent is empty (decks/decks.md D7); rejection filtered_parent.

delete_decks.description: deck-ops.md K5: delete decks with their subdecks and cards (decks/decks.md D8).

set_deck_collapsed.description: deck-ops.md K6: set study_collapsed or browser_collapsed of the decks (decks/decks.md D10).

add_preset.description: deck-ops.md K8: add a preset from the defaults (decks/deck-presets.md P4).

clone_preset.description: deck-ops.md K8: clone a preset (decks/deck-presets.md P5).

rename_preset.description: deck-ops.md K8: rename a preset (decks/deck-presets.md P6).

remove_preset.description: deck-ops.md K9: remove a preset, confirmed, moving its decks to fallback (decks/deck-presets.md P8); rejection default_preset. preset and fallback differ (checked when the scenario loads).

set_deck_preset.description: deck-ops.md K10: assign a preset to a deck, or to it and its subtree (decks/deck-presets.md P9); rejection filtered_deck.

handoff.description: Live scenarios (dsl.md D9.2): the side that runs the next steps; handoffs alternate.

add_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T2: a note type from scratch, shaped as a setup.notetypes entry.

add_stock_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T3: one of the six stock kinds, under its name or the given one.

clone_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T4: a copy of the named note type; name defaults to '<name> copy'.

update_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T5: edits applied in order to a draft of the named note type, saved once.

ensure_io_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T6: the on-demand Image Occlusion note type.

change_notetype_info.description: change-notetype-ops.md H1: the change screen opened on these notes with this target note type (stored name); rejections not_found, multiple_notetypes.

change_notetype.description: change-notetype-ops.md H2: the change saved for the latest change_notetype_info step, run as accepted; a missing map takes that step's default. Lengths and ordinals are checked against that step's note types when the step runs (invalid_scenario). Rejections no_changes, schema_changed, not_found, multiple_notetypes (Meguri's only).

empty_cards.description: empty-cards-ops.md Y1: the Empty Cards scan; the executor keeps its listed cards for the next delete_empty_cards steps.

delete_empty_cards.description: empty-cards-ops.md Y2: delete the cards the latest empty_cards step listed, with the Keep notes with no valid cards option.

remove_notetype.description: notetype-structure-ops.md M1: removes the named note type with its notes and cards; output none.

restore_notetype.description: notetype-structure-ops.md M2: Restore to Default with the given stock kind, or the stored one; output none, rejection needs_stock_kind.

notetype_edit.description: notetype-ops.md T5: one edit, a mapping with exactly one key; names refer to the draft as earlier edits left it.

tag.description: Draft (notetype-ops.md T5.1): null removes the tag.
